note: The valley's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Twisted Tower): Elder Moonpetal in the middle of the valley gives the first two, Warden Larkspur a few steps east of her the three hunts; Petalweaver Lissa, just west of the elder, is the outfitter; Coachman Tumbleseed keeps the stable on the grass to the north-west (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the dusk beetles (the west end of the valley), the valley ravens (the trees to the east) and the young drake Cindersnap (alone at the far east end) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Larkspur gives L7-L15, Moonpetal the L20 path; objectives on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Tumbleseed's coach), with the valley's laughter: badger claws, moonpetal thread, Old Frostjaw's claw, a shard for Halvek.

L1.name: A Fairy's Moonpetal Bracelet
offer: There you are, little friend! New wings, and already you want to be off, I can tell. Not yet. First you must have your moonpetal bracelet, as every fairy of the valley has.
Petalweaver Lissa braids them from the flowers that open at moonrise. She is just west of here.
Will you fetch your bracelet and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then dance a while first. The petals keep.
L1.started: Just to the west, little friend. You will smell the flowers before you see her.

piece.name: moonpetal bracelet
piece.description: A bracelet braided from the pale flowers that open at moonrise in the valley of the Twisted Tower. They do not wilt.

fetch.journal: Ask Petalweaver Lissa, just west of Elder Moonpetal, for a moonpetal bracelet.
fetch.says: Moonpetal sent you? Hold out your wrist. Three petals, braided thrice, and a laugh to seal it. There! A gift, little friend. They always are.

show.journal: Show the moonpetal bracelet to Elder Moonpetal.
show.says: Oh, it suits you! Wherever you go now, a little of the valley goes with you.

L2.name: Bound to the Valley
offer: The winds beyond the cliffs are rough with small wings, little friend. Have Spiritmaster Lirelle bind your spirit to the valley, so that you wake here if they throw you down.
Then give your name to Coachman Tumbleseed for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then stay under the trees, where the wind is kind.
L2.started: Lirelle is to the north-east, among the trees. Tumbleseed waits on the grass to the north-west.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Lirelle, north-east of the elder, bind your spirit to the valley.
bind.says: It is done, and it did not even tickle. Should the winds throw you down, you will wake here. Now off to Coachman Tumbleseed with you.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Tumbleseed, north-west of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A new name! I do like a new name. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good, good. Now the valley can always call you home.
Tumbleseed's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Qeynos is earned. Warden Larkspur, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Beetles at Dusk
offer: The new one! Splendid. The dusk beetles are out at the west end of the valley again, chewing the moonpetals down to the root. No petals, no bracelets, no laughing.
Bring me three of their eyes, and I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then Lissa will have words for both of us.
L3.started: Three eyes. West, as far as the valley goes. They glow, so you cannot miss them.

drop.name: dusk beetle eye
drop.description: The faintly glowing eye of a dusk beetle from the west end of the valley.

hunt.journal: Take three dusk beetle eyes from the dusk beetles at the west end of the valley.

give.journal: Bring three dusk beetle eyes to Warden Larkspur.
give.says: Three eyes, still glowing! The petals thank you. Now watch closely, little friend, and learn this.

L4.name: A Fairy's Arms
offer: Laughter is the oldest magic, but it does not stop a wolf. I will make you proper gear, if you fetch what I need.
Petalweaver Lissa has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then bring a tail feather from the valley ravens in the trees to the east.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then laugh very loudly, and fly very fast.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Lissa, a feather from the ravens. Off you go!

materials.journal: Ask Petalweaver Lissa for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Larkspur? Here they are: a strip of leather and a good straight shaft. Tell him the ravens have been at my thread again.

drop.name: valley raven feather
drop.description: A glossy black tail feather from a raven of the valley of the Twisted Tower.

hunt.journal: Take a valley raven feather from the valley ravens in the trees east of the elder.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the valley raven feather to Warden Larkspur.
give.says: All three! The feather for balance, the leather to bind... there. It is yours, little friend. It will fly true.

L5.name: Cindersnap
offer: One thing more, and it is no laughing matter. A young drake has come down off the slopes and made its den at the far east end of the valley. We call it Cindersnap. It has scorched two of our watchers.
It is small for a drake, which is still large for us. Strike first. Bring me one of its scales, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a new fairy.
Will you hunt Cindersnap?
L5.declined: It will only grow, little friend. Drakes do.
L5.started: East, past the ravens, where the valley ends. Keep out from under its jaws.

drop.name: Cindersnap's scale
drop.description: A warm, ember-coloured scale from the young drake Cindersnap.

hunt.journal: Take Cindersnap's scale from the young drake Cindersnap at the far east end of the valley.

give.journal: Bring Cindersnap's scale to Warden Larkspur.
says: Cindersnap's own scale, and still warm! The watchers will cheer you. You are a new fairy no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Starling by the north pass when you are ready for Qeynos.

flight.name: The Road to Qeynos
offer: The humans of Qeynos and the rangers of Surefall Glade are kind to fairies, and they will teach you all they know. Larkspur says you are ready.
You have earned the road, little friend. I will set you down among your own guild there, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to the humans?
flight.declined: The humans will wait. They are slower than we are.
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Starling when you are ready to go to the humans of Qeynos.

L7.name: Claws and a Laugh
offer: Little friend! The homes keep a hunters' outpost under the Goldfeather Eyrie, on the snow, and nobody there laughs. I mean to change that. You will help.
Ride Tumbleseed's coach there. Bring me two badger claws and a clump of rat fur from the snow east of the outpost. I will tell you the joke later.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow?
L7.declined: Then the joke waits. It is a good one.
L7.started: Two claws and some fur. And smile at the hunters as you pass!

drop.name: snowfield badger claw
drop.description: A blunt digging claw from a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two snowfield badger claws from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take a clump of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the badger claws and the drift rat fur to Warden Larkspur.
give.says: Claws, fur, and you, still in one piece! A tickle-stick for the hunters, you see. Never mind. Watch me, and learn this.

L10.name: Moonlight and Iron
offer: You need better than a toy now, little friend. Lissa has spun thread from moonpetals for me, and the Eyrie's quartermaster keeps iron.
Then bring me two pinions from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost. Moonlight, iron and an owl's quiet: a fine weapon.
Will you gather it all?
L10.declined: Then mind the old one does not break.
L10.started: Lissa, then Dunmore, then the owls. Off you go!

items.name: moonpetal thread
items.description: A spool of thread spun from moonpetals. It glows faintly in the dark.

materials.journal: Ask Petalweaver Lissa, beside Elder Moonpetal, for the moonpetal thread.
materials.says: Larkspur's thread! Spun at moonrise, all of it. Hold it up: see how it glows? A gift, of course.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for iron ore.
materials.says: A fairy, asking for iron? Ha! That is the first laugh this outpost has had all month. Here. Do not drop it on your wings.

drop.name: pale owl pinion
drop.description: A long white flight feather from a pale owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two pale owl pinions from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the moonpetal thread, the iron ore and the owl pinions to Warden Larkspur.
give.says: Thread, iron, feathers... and a wish, and a little laugh to seal it. There! It is yours, little friend. It strikes quiet as an owl.

L13.name: A Claw for the Watchers
offer: This is no laughing matter. A snow leopard the Eyrie folk call Old Frostjaw hunts the slopes north-east of their outpost, and he has killed three of them.
Bring him down and bring me one of his claws, and our watchers will hang it by the north pass to remind the cats. Take friends from the other homes.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
L13.declined: Then he hunts on. Do not let it be long.
L13.started: With friends, little friend. Always with friends.

drop.name: Old Frostjaw's claw
drop.description: A hooked claw as long as a finger, taken from Old Frostjaw.

hunt.journal: Take a claw from Old Frostjaw, on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring Old Frostjaw's claw to Warden Larkspur.
give.says: His claw! It is as long as I am. The watchers will cheer, and so do I. Learn this.

L15.name: The Heart Without a Laugh
offer: They say the Rimeheart in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost is a heart that never laughed, and the cold it makes is the cold of that.
Break it, little friend. Carry a shard to Warden Halvek so his outpost knows, and then come back and tell me how it went.
Will you break the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: Then the caves stay cold, and no one laughs.
L15.started: Go with friends, and go warm.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: A fairy broke the Rimeheart. Ha! I will never hear the end of it from the other homes. Tell Larkspur the Eyrie thanks the valley.

back.says: Halvek laughed? Halvek! Then you did two great things today. Learn this, little friend, the last I have.

L20.name: The Long Laugh
offer: Larkspur says you made the Eyrie's warden laugh, and broke its coldest heart. You are no new fairy now, little friend. You are a fairy of the Homelands.
The Eyrie's warden and scout have work for you still. Go to Warden Halvek at the outpost and do as they ask. Then come home, and choose your road.
Will you go back to the Eyrie?
L20.declined: Then rest, and come when the wind is right.
L20.started: Tumbleseed's coach will take you. Fly true!

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Moonpetal's fairy again! The scout needs a hand, and you have two. Scout Feyla is on the river's far reach. Go to her.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: The fairy who made Halvek laugh! The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Bring me three, and the river can rest.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Three talons! The river rests. Tell Dunmore at the outpost he can open the stores again, then go home.

after.journal: Tell Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost the river is safe.
after.says: Safe? Then the stores open, and tonight there will be laughing at the Eyrie. Go home, fairy. Your elder is waiting.

L20.picked: A happy choice! It is yours, little friend.

final.journal: Return to Elder Moonpetal in the valley.
final.says: Home again, and the whole Eyrie laughing behind you! That is the oldest magic, little friend. Keep it close.
